free_tier.stated: available on the Free plan: AI Gateway usage draws on the plan's credit pool, a 300 credit limit on Free, at 180 credits per USD 1 of model usage
free_tier.notes: derived: 300 credits / 180 credits per USD = USD 1.67 of model usage a month, shared with deploys, compute and bandwidth, which draw on the same credits. Derived: 90 credits per minute / 180 credits per USD = USD 0.50 of model usage a minute

endpoint: https://api.netlify.com/api/v1 (Netlify REST management API: GET /ai-gateway/providers, GET /sites/{site_id}/ai-gateway/token, GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/token); inference calls go to the runtime-injected base URL NETLIFY_AI_GATEWAY_URL (per-provider *_BASE_URL), literal host unverified
interface_detail: provider-native REST for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and OpenRouter through base URLs and keys that Netlify injects as environment variables in Netlify compute contexts. Control-plane routes are GET REST under https://api.netlify.com/api/v1; inference is POST REST to provider-specific paths under an injected base URL (/v1/chat/completions for OpenAI, /v1/messages for Anthropic, /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent for Gemini, /chat/completions for OpenRouter). Both coexist with the existing SDK description. Inference works only inside Netlify Functions/Edge Functions/CLI after at least one production deploy.
tooling: the official OpenAI, Anthropic, Google GenAI, OpenRouter and TypeSafe SDKs read the injected variables; no client tool is missing. curl can reach the unauthenticated GET /ai-gateway/providers discovery route. NETLIFY_AI_GATEWAY_KEY and NETLIFY_AI_GATEWAY_URL are injected for third-party or unsupported libraries only.
chaining: pairs with the Netlify Free plan recorded at compute/netlify, whose 300 credits it shares; a deployed Function can expose the gateway to a script
